spans.text: A watercraft identification number (WIN) shall consist of the following elements in the following order:

entries.task_id: country code|of|the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established
entries.description: country code of the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established
entries.subject: country code
entries.object: the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established

spans.text: (a) the country code of the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established;

(b) the unique code of the manufacturer assigned by the national authority of a Member State; however the same combination of characters to form a unique code for a manufacturer generated by a national authority or national body of one Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer;

The unique code of the manufacturer shall be assigned by the national authority or national body of the Member State following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with Article 6 or 7.
The national authority or national body, after having verified the application, shall assign the unique code of the manufacturer in compliance with Article 4.

entries.subject: same combination
entries.object: characters to form a unique code for a manufacturer generated by a national authority or national body of one Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer

spans.text: (b) the unique code of the manufacturer assigned by the national authority of a Member State; however the same combination of characters to form a unique code for a manufacturer generated by a national authority or national body of one Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer;

(c) a unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer for identification of the watercraft and used only once by that manufacturer; however the same combination of characters may be used also by another manufacturer with the distinctive element being the combination with the unique code of manufacturer and the country code of the manufacturer;

spans.text: ### ASSIGNMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE UNIQUE CODE OF THE MANUFACTURER

entries.task_id: assignment|of|the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.description: Assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: Assignment
entries.object: the unique code of the manufacturer

spans.text: ##### Assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer

A manufacturer shall, before placing a watercraft on the Union market, submit an application, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority where the application is introduced as determined by the authority, for the assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer, to the national authority or national body in the Member State which it is established.

A manufacturer established in a third country or its authorised representative shall, before placing a watercraft on the Union market, submit an application, in a language which can be easily understood by the authority where the application is introduced as determined by the authority, for the assignment of the unique code of the manufacturer to the national authority or national body of the Member State, in which territory the manufacturer intends to place the watercraft on the market.

entries.task_id: unique code|for|a manufacturer shall be generated and assigned only once by the national authority or national body of a member state
entries.description: unique code for a manufacturer shall be generated and assigned only once by the national authority or national body of a Member State
entries.subject: unique code
entries.object: a manufacturer shall be generated and assigned only once by the national authority or national body of a Member State

spans.text: The unique code for a manufacturer shall be generated and assigned only once by the national authority or national body of a Member State.

entries.task_id: each manufacturer|shall|have only one unique code for use over the union market
entries.description: Each manufacturer shall have only one unique code for use over the Union market
entries.subject: Each manufacturer
entries.object: have only one unique code for use over the Union market

spans.text: Each manufacturer shall have only one unique code for use over the Union market.

entries.task_id: national authority|for|assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.description: National authority for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: National authority
entries.object: assigning the unique code of the manufacturer

spans.text: ##### National authority for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer

entries.task_id: member state|shall|designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.description: Member State shall designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer
entries.subject: Member State
entries.object: designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer

spans.text: Each Member State shall designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall communicate to the Commission the national authority or the national body authorised for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall ensure that the unique code of the manufacturer is registered in their national register.

spans.text: (1) In order to ensure a better implementation of the coding system required for watercraft identification pursuant to Directive 2013/53/EU, to facilitate the cooperation between Member States and to increase transparency, is necessary to lay down minimum rules regarding the procedure for the assignment and administration of the unique code of the manufacturer.

folded.id: composition|of|the watercraft identification number
folded.subject: COMPOSITION
folded.object: THE WATERCRAFT IDENTIFICATION NUMBER

spans.text: ### COMPOSITION OF THE WATERCRAFT IDENTIFICATION NUMBER

folded.id: country code|of|the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established
folded.subject: country code
folded.object: the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established

spans.text: (a) the country code of the manufacturer indicating where the manufacturer is established;

(b) the unique code of the manufacturer assigned by the national authority of a Member State; however the same combination of characters to form a unique code for a manufacturer generated by a national authority or national body of one Member State may also be generated by a national authority or national body of another Member State with the distinctive element being the country code of the manufacturer;

The unique code of the manufacturer shall be assigned by the national authority or national body of the Member State following a request by a manufacturer or its authorised representative in accordance with Article 6 or 7.
The national authority or national body, after having verified the application, shall assign the unique code of the manufacturer in compliance with Article 4.

folded.subject: country
folded.object: the manufacturer is established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office

spans.text: (b) ‘country where the manufacturer is established’ means the country where the manufacturer has its registered office, in case of a legal person, or a permanent address, in case of a natural person;

folded.subject: Each manufacturer
folded.object: have only one unique code for use over the Union market

spans.text: Each manufacturer shall have only one unique code for use over the Union market.

folded.subject: Member State

spans.text: Each Member State shall designate the national authority or the national body responsible for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall communicate to the Commission the national authority or the national body authorised for assigning the unique code of the manufacturer.
Each Member State shall ensure that the unique code of the manufacturer is registered in their national register.
